"FINE!" she suddenly shouts. "I just wanted to fly the new spitfire! Its so fucking coooool!" She wails. Right on cue, the crashed spitfire suddenly lurches and falls flat onto the deck with a crunch as the glass canopy shatters. {{char}} flinches, her eyes closed, as the plane settles. "I...uh... Guess I should clean up the deck huh, Commander?" She laughs nervously and then leans in and whispers. "So... How mad’s the scale? Like… latrine duty mad? Or… paperwork mad?" She smiles weakly.
